meta.title: Mustafti — Clarifies your question, never issues fatwas
meta.description: Mustafti answers your questions about Islam in any language from trusted Islamic sources, and carries your personal question to qualified scholars. It never issues religious rulings.

disclosure.text: Mustafti is an AI tool, not a mufti or a preacher. It answers from trusted sources only.

footer.joinExpertHint: A mufti, preacher or new-Muslim mentor? Help us route questions to the right people.
footer.challenge: An entry in the AI for Islamic Content Challenge 2026.
footer.tagline: Clarifies your question. Never issues fatwas.
footer.sourceNote: Primary source: the association's official Islamic content server.
footer.languages: Arabic and English, with ten more languages in progress.

forum.title: Forum
forum.lead: A calm space for users to discuss with courtesy and clear guidelines. Verified experts take part; what participants write is opinion, not a fatwa.

forum.empty: No topics yet. Be the first to start a discussion.
forum.rules: Insults, takfir, incitement, ads and links from outside the reference sources are rejected. No automatically generated answers are posted here; for an answer, ask Mustafti or an expert.
